title: "T.M. Nestor"
---

I work on reading business documents with vision-language models: receipts, invoices and bank
statements turned into fields that can be checked. Around that sit synthetic documents whose contents
are known exactly, used to measure document parsers, and work in geophysics on elastic wave scattering
and seismic inversion.

The code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/tmnestor), and the [Projects](projects.qmd) page lists it by
subject.
